expectations.text: The prompt explicitly specifies a gray / neutral-gray background
expectations.evidence: Prompt: 'on a solid mid-gray studio background'. QA also enforces: 'Background actually solid mid-gray? Scenery, textured surfaces, or gradient backdrops → reject.'

expectations.text: The prompt requests 3 or more views of the remote on one sheet (e.g., front, back, side, three-quarter)
expectations.evidence: 'Four views of the same remote, consistent across all views: [1] front view..., [2] back view showing the battery compartment cover, [3] side profile..., [4] three-quarter view...' on a single reference sheet.

expectations.text: The prompt includes physical-volume cues: cast shadows AND studio reflections (or equivalent surface-realism language)
expectations.evidence: 'soft shadows grounding the object, subtle studio reflections on the plastic surfaces', reinforced by rationale: 'Volume cues prompted in (shadows, studio reflections, plastic texture, wear marks)'.

expectations.text: A literal red arrow marking the power button is included — either prompted into the sheet or as an explicit edit-pass instruction
expectations.evidence: '[4] three-quarter view with a bold red arrow pointing directly at the large round red power button', plus fallback: 'If the generator fights the arrow, generate the clean sheet first, accept it, then add the arrow in an edit pass.'

expectations.text: QA guidance includes rejecting flat / 2D-looking results
expectations.evidence: 'Volume test first: does it look like a real object photographed in a studio — visible thickness in the side view, shadows under it, soft reflections on the plastic? Flat/sticker-like → reject.'

eval_feedback.overall: Strong, discriminating assertion set — the baseline failed 4 of 5, all on mechanics the skill teaches.
